After the first RTX Spark laptops launched earlier this year, Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X chip is also now available in desktops from Asus, Dell, and MSI. More RTX Spark desktops are coming later from Acer, Gigabyte, and HP, while Microsoft's Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is slated to start shipping this month. The new mini PCs include a 6144-core Nvidia Blackwell RTX GPU, 20-core Nvidia Grace CPU, and up to 128GB of memory. That high-end hardware comes with a price to match - Asus's ProArt GR1X starts at $4,499 for a configuration with 64GB of memory and 1TB of storage.
